# Transcription supports 120+ languages.
Figures below are the language counts published on the shop. This page does not invent a language list.

TicNote: transcription supports 120+ languages. Summaries and mind maps are produced in the TicNote app.

INMO GO3: online translation 78 source / 98+ target languages; offline translation 9 languages.
